REFUTATION OF v5's LOCATION CLAIM, free and buildless, the exact command v5 nominated: `fnasm game/sys/memcard loadGauntletSave 0x1c:0x70 --diff`. v5 states 'The remaining gap is entirely in the prologue scaffold-store region @1c-6c' and asks the next lane to find 'the two branch sites' there. THERE IS NOT ONE BRANCH INSTRUCTION IN THAT WINDOW. The region is pure address-materialisation scaffold - lfs/lis/stw/addi against lbl_803472F0, lbl_80274578, optionsAudioAndPrefs30, cardRemovedCallback, lbl_8011CDE0, lbl_801131C0 - and what it actually contains is the ours-only -2 addi half of the multiset plus a slot/ordering difference, not the +2 b half. v5's own hypothesis.screened_against_target field says 'no' and admits the sites 'were NOT located in the target assembly this run'; this is that unscreened claim failing.

THE REAL LOCATION, from `fndiff --ops`: the +2 b are ONE cluster, `delete T[629:631]@9d4-9dc=['b','b'] O[630:630]@9d8-9d8=[]`, at 0x9d4 - 2.4 KB past the window v5 named. The +1 mr is separately at `replace T[596:598]@950-958=['lwz','mr'] O[598:599]@958-95c=['addi']`, also outside the prologue. So all three of v5's location claims for the multiset tokens are wrong; only the ours-only -2 addi is anywhere near @1c-6c.

THE CLASSIFICATION v5 ASKED FOR, done at the correct address via `fnasm game/sys/memcard loadGauntletSave 0x9b8:0x9fc --diff`. Target:
   9c0: cmpwi r3,-1
   9c4: beq ->9dc
   9c8: bge ->6c
   9cc: cmpwi r3,-2
   9d0: bge ->6c
   9d4: b ->9dc      <- TARGET ONLY
   9d8: b ->6c       <- TARGET ONLY
   9dc: addi r3,r30,832   <- the join block (the saveMenuPrompt(rpool + 832, ...) setup)
Ours runs the same compare chain and falls straight through into the join at its own 0x9d8. The two extra target words are the arm terminators of the switch at src/game/sys/memcard.c:1312-1322: `b ->9dc` is the `break` arm's branch and it targets THE VERY NEXT INSTRUCTION (a no-op branch), while `b ->6c` is the `default: goto retry;` arm's branch and is UNREACHABLE behind it. VERDICT: the false edge at this site targets 0x9dc, which is the JOIN block, not a return block. By claim.law.NV_ternary-cure-fails-when-branch-pair-target-is-a-join-block.20260901.v1 the one-case-switch carrier is EXCLUDED here - which is precisely the exclusion v5's cheapest_refuting_observation was designed to detect, reached at the correct address and at zero build cost.

Its cluster shape is distinctive and does not look like schedule noise: `insert T[590:590]@938 O[591:594]@93c-948=['li','lwz','stw']` then `delete T[593:595]@944-94c=['li','stw']` then `replace T[596:598]@950-958=['lwz','mr'] O[598:599]@958-95c=['addi']`. A target `lwz`+`mr` pair standing against our single `addi` is the signature of the target LOADING a value into a register and copying it where we compute an address in place - i.e. a held-pointer versus recomputed-address difference, the same family as the check_prefs_loaded mechanism recorded in this same TU.
